meta_description:
7,324 likes, 331 comments - drmarkhyman on October 30, 2026: "Lifting heavy weights may be one of the best things you can do for your brain.

A randomized controlled trial of 100,000 people found that heavy lifting, around 80% of your max for 5 to 6 reps, improved neural connectivity in the prefrontal cortex, the part of the brain that drives cognition.

Moderate weights and higher reps helped other areas of the brain. But only heavy lifting showed that prefrontal cortex response.

And it’s never too late to start. The participants were 60 and older.

Drop a YES below and I’ll DM you this full conversation with @drstacysims from The Dr. Hyman Show 🎧".
